concepts.title: India's Water Endowment
concepts.definition: India accounts for about 2.45 per cent of the world's surface area, 4 per cent of its water resources and about 17 per cent of its population, so the per capita water availability is far below the world average and declining with population growth.
concepts.key_idea: Dividing India's population share by its water share shows how many times harder the population presses on each unit of water than the world average.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy204.txt India water endowment passage (2.45 per cent area, 4 per cent water, 17 per cent population)

solution_steps.action: divide population share by water share

concepts.title: Water Demand and Conflicts
concepts.definition: Water demand divides among agriculture, domestic use, industries and power; rising demand creates inter-state river disputes and sectoral conflicts, making allocation, pricing and conservation politically charged issues.
concepts.key_idea: Irrigation takes the largest share, so farm efficiency measures free water for cities and industry.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy204.txt water demand sections and inter-state conflicts
question_patterns: name the sectors competing for water in India
why does irrigation dominate water demand
give examples of inter-state water disputes
how can demand management ease conflicts
relate groundwater overuse to falling water tables
explain the conflict between domestic and industrial users

solution_steps.explain: irrigation leads, then domestic, industrial and power uses
inter-state river disputes illustrate political scarcity
drip and sprinkler systems cut farm demand sharply

concepts.title: Watershed Management and Rainwater Harvesting
concepts.definition: Watershed management treats a drainage basin as a unit for soil and water conservation through check dams, contour bunds and vegetation, while rainwater harvesting captures rooftop and surface runoff; both revive local water security as shown by community efforts like Tarun Bharat Sangh's work and Tamil Nadu's rooftop laws.
concepts.key_idea: Local capture of rain recharges wells and revives streams, reducing dependence on distant reservoirs.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy204.txt watershed management and rainwater harvesting cases
question_patterns: define watershed management and its techniques
what does rainwater harvesting include
how did community efforts revive rivers in Alwar district
explain rooftop harvesting with a city example
relate check dams to groundwater recharge
evaluate watershed programmes against large dams

solution_steps.explain: the watershed organises conservation around natural drainage
check dams, contour bunds and vegetation slow and store runoff
Alwar's johads and rooftop laws show state and society acting together

concepts.title: Recycling and Conservation of Water
concepts.definition: Water conservation extends to recycling industrial effluents, treating sewage for reuse, pricing water to curb waste and reviving traditional structures; every saved unit of demand is cheaper than a new supply project.
concepts.key_idea: Demand-side conservation - meters, tariffs, recycling - is the cheapest new source of water.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy204.txt recycling and conservation measures sections
question_patterns: list conservation measures for industries and homes
how does pricing affect water use
explain sewage treatment as a water source
relate crop choice to water conservation
what are the gains of recycling effluents
compare supply-side and demand-side strategies

solution_steps.explain: recycling, pricing, metering and crop choice all cut demand
treating and reusing water costs less than damming new rivers

worked_examples.question_pattern: India has about 17 per cent of world population and 4 per cent of world water resources. Compute the population pressure index on water.

solution_template.explain: population 17 per cent, water 4 per cent
17 divided by 4 gives about 4.25 times world-average pressure

worked_examples.question_pattern: How did johads change the water scenario of Alwar district villages?

solution_template.explain: villagers revived small earthen check dams called johads
monsoon runoff slowed and seeped, raising groundwater
dried rivers began flowing again, showing community power over scarcity

worked_examples.question_pattern: Suggest two measures to reduce inter-state river water disputes.

solution_template.explain: joint gauging and transparent flow data reduce suspicion
efficient irrigation lowers each state's claimed share
tribunals plus efficiency make settlements durable
